family: R16-B breakthrough: 1m micro-trend agreement filter on frozen majority_1x (new information, not new prices)
hypothesis: The 5m-close decision may catch counter-micro-trend entries. Keeping only signals whose direction agrees with the 1m micro-trend strictly before signal_time (past-only information the 5m book does not encode as a filter) improves monthly net without collapsing fills. 1m-entry refinement is DEAD (v44); 1m INFORMATION as a filter is untested.

trend_formula.note: Micro-trend uses ONLY 1m bars with close_time <= signal_time (strictly causal, asserted at runtime). Window of L minutes before signal_time S: the L 1m bars with opens S.floor('min')-(L-1) .. S.floor('min') (close_times in (S - L min, S]).
trend_formula.trend: trend_L = last-1m-close (bar closing at S) - first-1m-open (earliest bar of window)
trend_formula.sign: trend_sign = +1 if trend_L > 0, -1 if trend_L < 0, 0 if exactly flat
trend_formula.agreement_rule: KEEP a frozen signal iff trend_sign == direction (+1 LONG / -1 SHORT). Flat (0) counts as DISAGREE (dropped). Geometry of kept signals is byte-identical to frozen (pure row filter; entry/stop/TP/holding untouched).
trend_formula.report_both: Both L variants are pre-specified here and both are reported; no cherry-picking the better L.

coverage_policy.keep_rule: A signal is trend-computable for lookback L iff ALL L expected 1m bars are present AND each has close_time <= signal_time (causal); else the signal is DROPPED for that L branch, count reported, NEVER extrapolated.
coverage_policy.control_full: control branches run on all 94 frozen signals (reproduction gate; untouched).
coverage_policy.trend_branches: trend60-agree runs on signals computable at L=60 AND agreeing; trend240-agree likewise at L=240. Different N per L is the disclosed filter effect, not a bug.
coverage_policy.precrawl_check: Verified BEFORE running (read-only probe, no tuning): L=5 79/94 full (matches B-1mentry); L=60 full=40/94 (part=40 with only the 5 own sub-bars, zero=14); L=240 full=40/94 (part=40, zero=14). Expect trend universes of 40 coverable signals each; agreement split unknown until run.

control: control_1x (94 signals, frozen geometry) must match B4 majority_1x published normal (+165.17829563633006% total_return 1.6517829563633004, -20.086073993367803% max_drawdown -0.20086073993367803, 63 trades) within 1e-6 / exact trades or STOP the run.

dd_guard_policy.rule: All 3 filter variants x both sizings = 6 pre-specified branches. dd_guard reference is THIS run's control_1x sampled equity (trade exit_time/equity_after), past-only 1-microsecond cutoff, 100.0 seed; trigger 10%, lev 0.5; applied at each branch's OWN signal times via leverage column only (geometry untouched).
dd_guard_policy.reference: control_1x this-run equity (not v03 own-book; disclosed deviation, same convention as v41/v44 shared-control reference).

monthly_note: monthly/annual geometric from parent_plan duration (complete_evaluation_until minus folds[0][0], 365.2425d year), same formula as v41/v44.

labels.causal: 1m bars strictly before/at signal_time only (close_time <= signal_time asserted); entry seeking still starts at t+1; no future information.
